sections.name: Loading
sections.title: Spinning loading screen
sections.what: Shows a full-screen, centered spinning ring with the line 'Securing your health session' underneath, with the text gently pulsing.
sections.why: Tells the user the app is working while the next page loads.
sections.watch_out: The message suggests a security check is happening, which is not true of this screen.

summary: The full-screen loading screen shown while a page is being prepared.
purpose: Shows a spinning circle and the words 'Securing your health session' so users know the app is working.
why: Next.js shows this file automatically while a page loads, so users do not see a blank screen.
how: It draws a centered column with a spinning ring and a gently pulsing line of text. It takes no input and always shows the same content.
outputs: A centered loading indicator with a short message.
risks: The message talks about securing a session, but no session check happens here, so the wording may suggest more than the screen does.
debug: If the loading screen stays up forever, the problem is usually in the page it is waiting for, not in this file. Check that the page loads its data.
